# shopify_collection (List Resource)

Lists all collections of the store, `frontpage` included. Generated config carries `product_ids` as product GIDs, which tie it to the store: replace them with `shopify_product` references. A collection whose membership can't be managed is listed without `match_type`, `conditions` and `product_ids`, with a warning.
